Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}", "{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"element_config\":{\"include_elements\":true,\"min_level\":\"word\"},\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"]}}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].ocrElements() as Any)
```
